text: {"assertions":["A corrupted scaffold bug in cli/commands/init.py caused generated trees to be missing one file when processing jobs scheduled across midnight boundaries.","The root cause was a missing composite database index on (tenant_id, created_at) that failed to properly track and order scaffold generation records.","The fix was implemented by adding the composite index and backfilling affected records in batches via PR #2404 on branch fix/corrupted-scaffold-1.","The bug could be reproduced by running the init command in a directory that already contains a lockfile.","After implementing the fix, throughput improved by 15 percent, reaching 928 requests per second.","The codebase uses Python and includes test coverage in tests/cli/test_init.py for this developer tooling component."]}
